text:
maria: Quick check — PR #4567 is about tenant-label examples and autoscale SLA wording. Can someone sanity-check the SDK snippet and the SLA paragraph? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4567 :eyes:
kevin: looking now. main question: did we choose namespaced labels or freeform? docs currently show freeform (tenant: alice) which breaks reserved-pool mapping in terraform example.
tara: we should prefer namespaced labels like redwood.tenant or tenant.id to avoid collisions. tiny change to examples will match infra runtime.
simon: agree with @tara. Also the SLA sentence about "best-effort preemption" is ambiguous. Suggest: "Dedicated capacity offers best-effort avoidance of preemption; when preemption occurs, requests are retried to a lower-tier model per routing policy."
maria: that wording seems clearer. Can we add a short example of a retry policy in the docs? simple YAML snippet would help.
olivia: added a proposed SDK snippet for Python to the PR comment. Paste here for visibility:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=... )
config = {
  "tenant_label": "redwood.tenant:acme-corp",
  "autoscale": {"min_replicas": 2, "max_replicas": 16, "cooldown_s": 120}
}
client.create_capacity_pool(**config)
```
kevin: that SDK call looks good, but call name is create_pool in our SDK v0.8 — small mismatch. Also add an example using label selector for provisioning: `tenant_selector: "redwood.tenant=acme-corp"`.
maria: good catch. I'll update the snippet. Also, infra asked for an explicit example showing fallback to hosted API when dedicated nodes are preempted. Proposed YAML for routing: 
```yaml
routing: 
  primary: dedicated://pool-acme
  fallback: hosted://gpt-3.5-redwood
  on_preempt: retry_with_fallback: true
```
tara: nit: `on_preempt` should be `on_preempt: {action: retry, fallback: hosted}` to match parser.
simon: one more ask from SRE: add a link to the dedicated capacity runbook and note the SLO implication (latency SLO may degrade for fallback path). Maybe a parenthetical near the SLA line: `(see runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-fallback)`
doc-bot: PR #4567 assigned to @maria, reviewers @kevin @tara. Reminder: run doctests with `make docs-test` before merging. (automated)
maria: thanks all — I'll push edits: rename to `create_pool`, switch to namespaced labels, adjust YAML action format, add runbook link, and clarify SLA sentence to Simon's phrasing.
olivia: once updated, can someone from infra glance at the terraform snippet too? it maps tenant labels into `reserved_pool` tag and we've seen a mismatch cause failed applies.
kevin: I can check terraform after the docs push. If we need tiny TF change, I'll open a follow-up PR.
simon: if you want, add a single-line compatibility note: "If you're migrating from v1 labels, run `scripts/migrate-labels.sh`" and link the script.
maria: will do. ETA: I should have the updated PR by EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
